'''Ro-San Borokki''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. An 18-year veteran of the Guild, Borokki served as Director of Training for the Guild, sometime during the tenure of [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]] as the Guild's Head.<ref name="The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett" />

During her time as Director of Training, Ro-San had contributed to the [[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]]. Titled "The Hunt", Borokki's contribution to the handbook covered the SEPI principle and how to survive a hunt.<ref name="The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett" />
